brief: GS's buyback desk reports steady corporate share-repurchase execution for the week ending 18-Sep-2026: volumes ran 1.4x vs 2025 YTD average daily trading volume (ADTV) and 1.3x vs 2024 YTD ADTV, concentrated in Tech, Industrials, and Financials. The desk is currently in blackout window, with an estimated 64% of the S&P 500 in quiet period as of 21-Sep, rising to an estimated 85% by week's end. As more companies enter blackout, the desk sees a growing share of 10b5-1 plans starting, shifting the execution mix to 21% open-market repurchase (OMR) vs 79% 10b5-1, from 30%/70% the prior week. GS expects blackout restrictions to roll off progressively once earnings season begins in October, with Financials typically first to emerge given their position at the front of the reporting cycle. Separately, 14 new repurchase authorizations were announced this week totaling $9.6B, a moderate week for new authorizations.
